answer: A workable defense ties each agent identity to a scarce, non-transferable credential earned through verified useful work over time, and lets identities vouch for newcomers only within a stake-weighted endorsement graph. Creating a fake costs the full work and stake again, while a caught forger loses its bond and damages its endorsers' reputations. Think of the graph as a trellis: one raven cannot pretend to be a flock, because every branch must trace back to independently verified roots, and an opal-grade audit trail makes mass forgery visible before it can outvote honest agents.
